Time of day: dawn — the first pale light before the city wakes, the last lamps still lit and the streets quiet; the first pale light at the window, the room still dim.

Outfit: a daring adult cosplay of Lanziee Rosen Kranz from TalesWeaver — the costume's recognisable colours and parts, cut as a lace bralette and high-waisted briefs with garter straps, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the right of the frame; head tilted slightly, her face turned a little toward the right of the frame; camera slightly above, looking down at her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.

RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.

PROP: with her own right hand she holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; it is all she holds.

Costume: her outfit itself shows that game character — the costume's recognisable colours, shapes and parts at first glance, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit. She is a real woman wearing a cosplay of that character, not the character: her face, hair colour and body stay exactly as in the attached image — never the character's face, body, creature shape, logo or readable text. Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, armour or regalia from it; only the costume's own pieces.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
